defects.title: A failed exit-hatch autosave (D) is never retried and the run drops to the title
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/main.gd:1212 (_finish_chapter_close) together with _leave_junction (~line 1415) and _interact (line 1036); docs: apps/docs/content/docs/controls/saves.mdx (failed-save paragraph)
defects.detail: The only retry for save_pending is at the top of _interact(). When autosave D fails in _leave_junction, the closing beat starts and its CONTINUE press goes to _finish_chapter_close, which returns straight to the title because junction_cleared is set. _interact never runs, so the write is never retried. Continue then loads autosave C: the sentry is down and the bolt has to be popped again. This stays within the rule that a retry loses at most the current beat, but saves.mdx says 'Your next interact press ... tries the save again', which is not true in this one case. Fix options: retry before _return_to_title, or add one sentence to the docs. Low impact.

syncReview.checks:
Everything was run from the worktree at HEAD 934f1b2 (the merge of 567b362 and dc383dc). Both the worktree and the main checkout are clean.

- `bun run game:check` passed: changelog export matches, second import is clean, and all 11 suites pass (chapter_scene, hold_use, impact, junction, m0_scene, m0_state, room_depth, sentry, settings, sfx_bank, ui_controls).
- `bun run docs:check`, `bun run docs:build` and `bun run docs:test` all exited 0. The export guard passed on 25 pages and the planned-platform test passed.
- To check determinism, I re-ran impact_test, sfx_bank_test and junction_test three times each. All passed every time, with sound generation at 39 to 48 ms against the new 400 ms bound.

**The merge**
- I checked the remerge diff of all 17 conflicted files. No conflict markers remain anywhere in the tree. Main's Phase 3 wording and structure were kept, and the three-room facts were re-applied to them.
- Changelog bullets: branch 81 + main 64 − merge base 51 = 94 in the merge. No bullet is lost or duplicated, none is invented, and the October 9 section sits above October 8. The generator output matches changelog.txt byte for byte.
- Asset register: 25 entries with 44 file references, none missing. Every tracked media file under apps/game/assets, apps/docs/public and apps/docs/app is registered. Five entries were dropped on purpose because their files were deleted (four old room or prop sheets, plus the old corridor-source-build capture). The rest are the union of both sides, with main's WebP, WOFF2 and share-card details and the branch's redraw and Service Junction notes combined.
- README: the commands match package.json, the image paths exist, and the link targets resolve. The table adds Hold E / Hold A / Hold CRANK.
- Every internal /docs link in the content resolves. Nav order is right: the root, the Play and settings section, and the walkthrough as corridor, records-access, service-junction. Following main's convention, the walkthrough index is left out of the pages list. No stale "two rooms", "Chapter help" or "silent build" text remains.

**The four commits**
- **8f6fb36 (spent line and saves):** PressureLine.reset(spent) leaves the line in the blown state, so arm() and crank() refuse it and advance() returns nothing. A guarded `_door_blast` means a blown door cannot blow again. On a blast knockdown the restore through `_load_game` resets the line to idle. All four autosaves and Continue restore correctly.
  - `save_pending` with the beat snapshot is sound. Every autosave marks the beat first. A knockdown uses the in-memory snapshot when the last write failed or the file cannot be read. New Game and Continue clear the flag. No snapshot is marked without a save in Records Access or the junction, so the snapshot always matches the failed autosave.
  - The new tests cover a failed write, the retry on the next USE and an unreadable file.
- **d4fe540 (plates):** I compared the two cropped near plates against the left 512 px of the originals: pixel-identical. All six plates have dimensions that are multiples of 4. ETC2/ASTC import is enabled in project.godot, so mobile exports can use the compressed textures. The base fill is skipped only when a far plate exists, and room_depth_test checks coverage at every framing, including touch with shake.
- **81b72d6 (tests):** the hit-stop test now calls the shorter stop's own timeout through its serial number. Since `_end_hit_stop` compares serials, the test is deterministic.
- **567b362 (docs):** the October 9 bullets and the input, saves and troubleshooting text match the code.

One documentation-only defect in saves.mdx is listed under defects (severity 1). It does not affect the result.

defects.title: VALVE label stays at '0 / 3' while the valve is being cranked
defects.detail: sync_line() only calls refresh_state() when line_state changes, not when turns changes. The label text 'VALVE  %d / %d' is set only in refresh_state(), so it reads 'VALVE 0 / 3' through turns 1 and 2. The reviewer still 10-charging-at-valve.png shows 'VALVE 0 / 3' while the turn lights show 2 green and the status and hint say '2 of 3 turns' (line.turns=2, state building). The label only changes when the state becomes charged and it switches to SEAL CHARGED. This bug was already in HEAD~1, but it is a wrong state readout in a still this review covers. Fix: call refresh_state() when turns != previous_turns. junction_test does not assert the label during cranking.

defects.title: The sentry wreck is almost hidden under the landed tank
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:528-532 (sync_arm sets the tank base on FLOOR_Y) and 411-424 (tank drawn over the sentry); apps/game/scripts/main.gd:1583
defects.detail: After a hit, the tank (46x84 px) lands with its base on the floor (y 440), right on top of the 59 px wide wreck, and it draws over the wreck. Only about 6 px of crushed tread and debris shows on each side. In 34-sentry-down.png and 40-camera-right-end.png the room reads as a tank standing on the floor, not as a crushed sentry. The new junction-sentry-down.png art barely shows. The status line still says 'The sentry keels over and its eyes go dark', which no longer describes the art. Suggested fix: stop the tank on top of the wreck (lift the landed tank by the wreck's crushed height, about 25-30 px), or offset or draw the wreck so it reads. Then update the line, the walkthrough ('knocks the sentry over') and the sentry_test landed-position assertions to match.

defects.title: With touch framing and camera shake, a strip of far wall shows below the junction walkway
defects.detail: In the junction, the floor is painted on the mid plate (opaque from source row 776 down; the corridor's mid plate is transparent there and its floor comes from the far plate). The mid plate therefore ends at world y 440 + (1080-776)*0.5 = 592. Touch play frames y 392±200, so the bottom of the view is exactly 592, and a +10 shake shows world 592-602 (about 13 screen px). Those pixels come from the far plate's bottom wall panels, not the floor. The t2-touch-left-shake.png still shows the texture change in the bottom rows. It is dark and mostly under the dialogue card, so it is subtle. room_depth_test only checks the mid plate horizontally, so it misses this. Fix: drop the mid plate a few px or check vertical coverage when the floor lives on the mid plate, and add that check.

fix.summary:
I checked all four reviewer defects against the code. All four were real, so I fixed all of them in one commit, 7aba70b, on codex/game-presentation in the worktree. Nothing was pushed, the main checkout was not touched and no capture driver was committed.

1. VALVE label stuck at '0 / 3' while cranking (sev 2). JunctionRoom.sync_line now calls refresh_state() when the turn count changes, not only when the state changes. junction_test now checks that the label reads 'VALVE  1 / 3' after the first turn.

2. Sentry wreck hidden under the landed tank (sev 2).
- The tank now stops on top of the crushed sentry instead of on the floor. The rest height is a new constant, Sentry.WRECK_CRUSH_HEIGHT (about 25.4 px), taken from the top of the crushed body on the wreck art (source row 340).
- Only a hit uses that height. While the tank falls and the sentry is in the hit window, it aims for the top of the wreck, so contact lines up with the hit and the tank never jumps upward. A miss still lands on the floor.
- On a hit, main._tank_hit now pins the sentry's position and the wreck to the floor mark (x 700). Continue from autosave C already put it there; before this, a live hit left the wreck wherever it was, up to 44 px off the mark. Sentry.keel_over now takes that x.
- The status line now reads 'The tank comes down square and crushes the sentry flat. Its eyes go dark.'
- The walkthrough now says 'crushes the sentry under the tank'. The October 9 art bullet in the changelog notes the tank resting on the crushed sentry, and I regenerated changelog.txt.
- sentry_test has a new _check_crushed check, run after the hit, the timed hit and Continue. It confirms the wreck is on the mark, the tank's base sits on the crushed body, at least 20 px of wreck shows down to the floor, and the wreck shows past both sides of the tank. A miss is checked to land on the floor.

3. Far wall showing below the junction walkway with touch framing and shake (sev 1). Lowering the mid plate would have moved the walkway off the floor line, so instead RoomDepth adds a 16 px mirrored strip below the mid plate. It runs past both room edges, so the bottom corners are covered too. In the corridor and Records that strip is transparent, so nothing changes there. room_depth_test now also checks that this strip spans the view's width and reaches its bottom, in every framing and shake.

4. SEALED DOOR / DOOR DOWN label on the painted wheel (sev 1). The door label moved up 5 px, from y 276 to 271 (new constant DOOR_LABEL_Y). It now sits between the gauge box and the wheel; the stills show it clear of both.

The stills were rendered with both reviewer drivers, copied as fix_junction_review.gd and fix_junction_touch.gd. These are framing and readout checks only; no hands-on play has happened, so feel and readability are not validated.

defects.title: WOLF walks straight through the sentry every time he chooses to draw it
defects.location: apps/game/scripts/main.gd:1473 (bait_x handed to SentryBrain as soon as wolf.position.x > LANE_ENTRY_X) with JunctionRoom.WOLF_BAIT_X (junction_room.gd:92) and SentryBrain._hold_on (sentry_brain.gd)
defects.detail: After answer 1 with the relay risk disclosed, WOLF walks from the rubble (x 448) to WOLF_BAIT_X (760). The sentry becomes fixated once WOLF passes x 545 and drives to the mark (700) at 230 px/s, faster than WOLF's 220. WOLF ends on the far side of a sentry he started on the near side of, so he always walks through its body (the sentry has no collision layer or mask, and WOLF draws on top at z 2). A headless probe run from autosave B with the answer given at four patrol phases (sentry at 728, 639, 779 and 761 when answered) found the closest centre gap was 1.0 px every time. The bodies touch below 57 px, and they overlapped for 27 to 31 of 180 frames. The parked end state is clear, which is what sentry_test checks, but the walk in is not. The changelog and walkthrough describe the sentry stopping clear of WOLF, while on screen he passes through the machine that is supposedly locked onto him. Possible fixes: hold the fixation until WOLF has passed the mark, or route WOLF's target so he never crosses the sentry.

defects.title: Sound-bank test leaks 8 objects at exit and the check script does not catch it
defects.location: apps/game/tests/sfx_bank_test.gd (end of _run); scripts/check-game.sh only greps for ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR
defects.detail: The sfx_bank_test.log of this run ends with 'WARNING: 8 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit'. The suite still reports pass because check-game.sh ignores WARNING lines. This only affects the test, not the game, but a leak in the new audio path would go unnoticed. The likely cause is that the generated AudioStreamWAV and player instances are still held when quit() runs after game.queue_free() and the 0.1 s wait.

defects.title: The two new shader files under apps/game/assets have no manifest entry
defects.detail: The repository rule is that every file under apps/game/assets needs a manifest entry. These two files are mentioned only in the manifest's prose 'status' field ('three small shaders (two files ...)') and have no asset entry with a path. There is precedent on main: game_theme.tres, the font .tres files and the OFL .txt files also have no entries. Both shaders are code rather than art, so this is a gap in the register's rules rather than a provenance risk. Either add entries or state the exemption for code files under assets.

defects.title: HEAD commit has a machine-local author and committer email
defects.location: commit 7aba70b 'Fix the junction review findings on labels, wreck and floor'
defects.detail: Author and committer are 'Nathanial Henniges <[local git author]>'. The other 21 branch commits use [GitHub noreply address]. The likely cause is committing with HOME pointed at the scratch home, so git did not find ~/.gitconfig and generated an identity from the hostname. If this merges to main, the machine hostname becomes public and GitHub cannot link the commit to the account. Amend it before merging, for example with `git commit --amend --reset-author --no-edit` under the real HOME.

finalFix.summary:
I re-checked all 11 reported defects against the code. All of them were real; two were duplicates (the shader entries and the junction screenshot each appeared twice). I fixed them on codex/game-presentation in the worktree. HEAD is now 16610a4. Nothing was pushed, and the main checkout is still clean.

1. Machine-local email on commit 7aba70b (severity 2): I amended it to the noreply identity, so it is now 63d0ebd. All 27 commits in origin/main..HEAD now use [GitHub noreply address]. I made every later commit with the real HOME.

2. WOLF walked through the sentry (severity 2): confirmed and fixed. WOLF now draws the sentry from the rubble side. WOLF_BAIT_X = MARK_X - BAIT_OFFSET, which puts him at 636. SentryBrain._hold_on now parks the sentry at bait_x + BAIT_OFFSET, so it stops on the mark, facing WOLF. I raised BAIT_OFFSET from 60 to 64 so that after a missed drop, when the sentry turns on the engineer, it still stays clear of WOLF as he backs off. While the sentry is chasing the engineer, WOLF now waits at the rubble. I re-ran the reviewer's probe. The closest gap between their centres went from 1.0 px to 65 px at all four patrol phases (the bodies touch below 57 px), with no overlapping frames. New tests check WOLF's walk in and his back-off at 40 patrol phases, and the scene test now checks the walk in.

3. WOLF hidden behind the blown door (severity 3): confirmed and fixed. The junction room is added after the actors, so at the same z the door drew on top of them. The torn frame now draws one step behind the actors (BLOWN_DOOR_Z = 0). The sealed door is unchanged. junction_test now checks that the frame draws behind both actors.

4. Sound-bank test leak (severity 1): confirmed and fixed. Run on its own, the test leaked 8 objects (4 sound clips and their 4 playbacks) in 5 of 5 runs. Raising the wait before quitting from 0.1 s to 0.5 s fixed it in 6 of 6 runs. scripts/check-game.sh now fails any test that reports objects leaked at exit.

5 and 11. Shader files had no manifest entry, and three screenshot entries had no terms_reference (severity 1): fixed. The manifest now has entries for both shaders, game_theme.tres, the three font .tres files and the two font licence texts. All three screenshot entries now have a terms_reference. The status text now says that Godot's .import and .uid files and the manifest itself are not registered. A script check found every registered path exists, every entry has the required fields, and no file under assets or site image is unregistered.

6. Landing and guide screenshots showed retired art (severity 2): confirmed and fixed. 4 and 8. Junction screenshot was older than the label fix (severity 1): confirmed and fixed. I recaptured the title, corridor-start and junction-entry stills from this build. Each is a 960x540 PNG plus WebP copies from cwebp 1.6.0 at 960 and 480 px. Captions now say October 10, 2026, because the captures were taken on the local date October 10. The title alt text now matches the current layout, with CHANGELOG at the lower left. The manifest entries for these captures are updated.

9. Out-of-date manifest descriptions (severity 1): fixed. The junction-tank entry now says it rests on the crushed hull after a hit. All three mid-plate entries now describe the new strip under the floor, since that code is shared by every room. The junction-sentry-down entry now says the wreck is pinned on the mark.

10. Credits missing Tailwind CSS and the image tools (severity 1): fixed. The credits page adds Tailwind CSS 4 and a new image-processing row (Pillow, ImageMagick, cwebp, and Chrome through Playwright). The in-game BUILT WITH block now lists Tailwind CSS, Pillow, ImageMagick and cwebp.

Other changes:
- The walkthrough no longer says WOLF "runs past the mark".
- I added an "## October 10, 2026" changelog section, regenerated changelog.txt and committed it.
- While checking, I found an existing flaky test in sentry_test ("the cloud arms its hurtbox"). It waited one physics frame for something that updates in the game's _process step, and it failed once. It now waits up to 5 frames, and 3 straight full runs passed.

Commits: 1f8f3aa (sentry and door fixes), aba016d (leak check), b9dc53f (credits), 7658359 (screenshots and asset register), 16610a4 (changelog).
